title.zh: 将宿务省 Daanbantayan 市镇 Tapilon 描笼涯的 Calape 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Tapilon 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Calape National High School - Tapilon Annex in Barangay Tapilon, Municipality of Daanbantayan, Province of Cebu From the Calape National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Tapilon National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Calape National High School - Tapilon Annex in Barangay Tapilon, Municipality of Daanbantayan, Province of Cebu From the Calape National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Tapilon National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Tapilon của Trường Trung học Calape Quốc gia tại Barangay Tapilon, Đô thị Daanbantayan, Tỉnh Cebu khỏi Trường Trung học Calape Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Tapilon Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Tapilon ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Calape แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Tapilon เทศบาล Daanbantayan จังหวัด Cebu ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Calape แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tapilon แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Tapilon, Sekolah Menengah Calape Nasional di Barangay Tapilon, Kotamadya Daanbantayan, Provinsi Cebu dari Sekolah Menengah Calape Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tapilon Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Tapilon, Sekolah Menengah Calape Kebangsaan di Barangay Tapilon, Perbandaran Daanbantayan, Wilayah Cebu daripada Sekolah Menengah Calape Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tapilon Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Calape National High School – Tapilon Annex in Barangay Tapilon, Municipality of Daanbantayan, Province of Cebu is hereby separated from the Calape National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Tapilon National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Calape National High School-Tapilon Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Tapilon National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Tapilon National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Calape National High School – Tapilon Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Department of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
